proposal.reason: The substantive change is to open-source test workflow execution: dual-platform (M890P + OAM-810E) case generation/selection/grouping, runner allocation/rack policy, optional HPN SDK install in build/test jobs, expanded native unit coverage, and reconciliation/report metadata updates. The large added/updated xtest definitions (including patch_omitted postsil_unit_test_shm.json) support CI dataset generation and validation rather than product runtime modules.
